2609.18470.title: Divide and Conquer: Mixture-of-Bottleneck Experts in Informative Ordinal Space for Video-based Multimodal Sentiment Analysis
2609.18470.paper_summary: Video-based Multimodal sentiment analysis (MSA) must handle information from text, audio, and image sequence in human speaking videos, yet current methods often fail to integrate modalities with task awareness. Most models treat video sentiment prediction as a single task, overlooking its ordinal nature, and their fusion strategies struggle to capture diverse unique and synergic cues across modalities. To address these limitations, we adopt a divide-and-conquer perspective by reformulating MSA as an ordinal regression problem and decoupling it into polarity recognition and intensity prediction. Driven by information theory, we introduce a Mixture-of-Bottleneck (MoB) framework that assigns different latents to polarity- and intensity-specific experts for different modalities. With the learning of information bottleneck, each expert learns compact and task-relevant representations while filtering out redundancy and noise. A multimodal bottleneck routing fusion module then fuses these expert latents with hard mining strategy, guiding the prediction in the ordinal sentiment space. Extensive experiments on 4 MSA datasets and 4 language models show that MoB effectively leverages informative latents from diverse modalities and captures general sentiment structure. Beyond stronger performance, MoB comprehensively captures fine-grained intra- and inter-modal dynamics, enabling more trustworthy localization of nuanced video sentiment signals.
2609.18470.paper_summary_zh: 視頻基礎的多模態情感分析（MSA）必須處理來自文本、音頻和人類講話視頻中的圖像序列的信息，但目前的方法往往無法以任務意識整合模態。大多數模型將視頻情感預測視為單一任務，忽略了其序數特性，而它們的融合策略難以捕捉跨模態的多樣獨特和協同線索。為了解決這些限制，我們採用分而治之的視角，將MSA重新表述為序數回歸問題，並將其解耦為極性識別和強度預測。受信息理論的驅動，我們引入了一種瓶頸混合（MoB）框架，為不同模態的極性和強度特定專家分配不同的潛在變量。在信息瓶頸的學習下，每個專家學習緊湊且與任務相關的表示，同時過濾冗餘和噪聲。然後，一個多模態瓶頸路由融合模塊使用硬挖掘策略融合這些專家潛在變量，引導在序數情感空間中的預測。在4個MSA數據集和4個語言模型上的廣泛實驗顯示，MoB有效利用來自多樣模態的信息潛在變量，並捕捉一般情感結構。除了更強的性能外，MoB全面捕捉細緻的內部和跨模態動態，使得對細微視頻情感信號的定位更具可信度。
